theses.thesis: T1: Operating margin stays above 29% in 2026 as content amortization grows slower than revenue.
theses.signpost: Q4 2026 results (January 2027): full-year 2026 operating margin at or above 29%.

theses.thesis: T2: The WBD financing will absorb cash that would otherwise fund buybacks, so the 2027 repurchase pace falls below 2025's $9.1 billion.
theses.signpost: Q1 2027 results (April 2027) and the WBD closing update: repurchases below $9.1 billion annualized and debt drawn under the bridge.

theses.thesis: T3: The current price needs growth above consensus for a decade, so returns are below the cost of capital unless growth beats expectations.
theses.signpost: Q4 2026 results (January 2027): FY2026 revenue at or above $51.1 billion, and FY2027 EPS consensus of $3.76 held or raised.

theses.thesis: T4: Free cash flow will keep covering buybacks, but only if operating cash flow grows faster than content spending.
theses.signpost: Trailing twelve-month free cash flow above $11 billion at each quarter-end through Q4 2026.
